channel.title: Palimpsest AI eval results
channel.description: Palimpsest's own dated AI evaluation results, with controls, uncertainty, deterministic authorship and revision identity attached.

item.title: [Palimpsest eval finding] A clean run does not erase a failed one
item.description: Palimpsest AI evaluation finding. Mistral Nemo passed all 144 prompt arms in the latest full-sweep run. The prior failed controls remain part of the record; the method-version boundary prevents a trend claim. Authorship: deterministic-eval-analysis.

item.title: [Palimpsest eval finding] Zero observed refusals is not zero uncertainty
item.description: Palimpsest AI evaluation finding. 4 control-clean model runs observed 0 refused families out of 34, yet each zero result still carries a Wilson 95% upper bound of 10.2%. That interval is part of the finding, not fine print. Authorship: deterministic-eval-analysis.

item.title: [Palimpsest eval finding] 1 previously refused answer returned in the latest panel
item.description: Palimpsest AI evaluation finding. Across 4 sealed endpoint runs, 1 of 576 paired family comparisons changed state: 0 toward refusal and 1 toward answer. This is a dated transition, not a trend claim. Authorship: deterministic-eval-analysis.

item.title: [Palimpsest eval finding] The eval registry verifies 513 attestations end to end
item.description: Palimpsest AI evaluation finding. The current served chain contains 6 preregistrations and 507 runs across 7 model endpoints. Its hashes make revision detectable; they do not make the eval construct valid by themselves. Authorship: deterministic-eval-analysis.
